projection.successRule: false only for execution_error; rejection, stale_basis, unavailable and unknown are domain outcomes, not affirmative execution claims

hostPolicy.completionRoute: new command_ingress-admitted command, not implemented here
hostPolicy.bootstrap: Host binds the conversation to an admitted session; read_model_summary takes no arguments and returns its handle and basis. Handles do not establish identity or authority.
hostPolicy.handles: Host-issued opaque workspace/proposal/run/page handles; scoped to admitted generation and workspace; never filesystem paths. Restart invalidates handles; unavailable/unknown, never redispatch. Cursor binds tool, basis, run and next offset.
hostPolicy.attribution: Host stamps author_type=agent and original conversation/turn/call; never accepts user attribution from tool arguments.
hostPolicy.proposal: Require claimedModelHash == basis.modelHash == current session hash before queue registration. The agent supplies native EditorOperationIntent operation_id, operation_kind, target, change and rationale; the schema closes change_kind and field_path to the admitted set, so no modifiers field, bend realization, bend insertion or library record can be proposed: the person enters every k and SIF. The host stamps operation_status=proposed, author_type=agent, queue_id, source, not-run validation and the constant audit and professional boundary records, and passes the complete native intents to a host-created OperationBatch. No alternate field-edit language. After schema validation the host admits each operation only if its operation_kind, object_type, change_kind and field_path match one admittedOperations row; the summary lists the same kinds. The Rust applier remains the semantic validator, including each kind's object type, field, unit, dimension and before text; it refuses agent-written modifiers. Queue the immutable submission via the existing preview/human apply route.
hostPolicy.completion: Resolve requestRef to the immutable original pending call and require its conversation/turn/call/tool, workspace and application-generation binding. The submitting webview must remain the admitted session. For summary/node reads require unchanged live revision through completion. For queued proposals, observations, solves and result reads validate the host-retained proposal/run record against its captured basis; a later live revision is permitted only as an explicitly historical/applied outcome, never rebased to current. Duplicate or forged completions and wrong/detached sessions are refused. Preserve already admitted application outcome as actual or unknown on loss; never redispatch.
hostPolicy.interruption: Withdraw pending review only; application already admitted yields actual outcome or unknown. Turn interruption is not solve cancellation or rollback.
hostPolicy.limits: Apply the smaller of catalog caps and existing admission budgets before parsing/allocating argument or result payloads; bounded producers, no whole-model serialization followed by truncation.
hostPolicy.results: Use existing permitted view/value-record semantics and redaction floors. No raw private row bypass. Preserve exact decimal where required; withheld/unavailable has no numeric value. A run handle binds its evaluated model hash, never relabel historical results as current.
hostPolicy.autonomy: No apply/accept/release/grant tools. Any later autonomy needs separately authorized host policy and implementation.
hostPolicy.solve: Require claimedModelHash == basis.modelHash == current session hash before handleRun; retain evaluated hash even if run id changes. Return session solverMode, health and run handle; progress only to existing supported notifications/panel.
hostPolicy.proposalContext: Require an explicit bounded assumptions array (empty means none declared), separate from unchanged native operation intents and per-operation rationale. Each assumption has a stable id, statement and existing affected operation ids. Validate id uniqueness and operation membership; capture immutable context with proposal handle, batch id, original attribution and basis. Display it with the queue and retain it with session outcomes/receipts, including reject/withdraw/unknown; do not inject extra fields into native intents or claim durable persistence.
hostPolicy.basisAdmission: Summary has no caller basis. Node reads, proposal submission and solve admission require the current live basis. Proposal observation uses the host-retained proposal basis; result reads use the host-retained evaluated run basis. All require the admitted workspace/application generation. Historical calls are not refused solely because the current model revision advanced.

tools.name: swbpipe_propose_operations
tools.description: Queue operations as one atomic batch for the person's review; never applies them. Steps apply in order, so later steps may name ids created earlier. Send only operation_id, operation_kind, target, change, rationale; the host stamps the rest. Use the summary's basis and hash. after is JSON text; quantities are {value, unit}; every record needs id, label (not primitive loads) and provenance (the person's stated source). Kinds as operation_kind/object_type/change_kind/field_path [unit; dimension; before]: create/Material/create_material/materials [project stress unit; stress; not_present]: elastic_modulus and either shear_modulus or constitutive_basis "homogeneous_isotropic_E_nu_v1" with poisson_ratio (unit "1"); optional thermal_expansion_coefficient (1/degC). create/Node/create_node/nodes [length unit; length; not_present]: position {x,y,z}. connect/Element/connect_pipe_run/pipe_segments [length unit; length; not_present]: from, to, material, y_reference {x,y,z} (not parallel), section {outside_diameter, wall_thickness, corrosion_allowance before exact route}. insert/Component/insert_component_symbol/components [none; dimensionless; not_present]: kind, node, geometry. bend: bend_pipe_ref, bend_radius, bend_angle, bend_geometry_source_reference. tee: branch_header_pipe_ref, branch_branch_pipe_ref, branch_run_size, branch_header_size, branch_connection_angle, branch_connection_type, branch_reinforcement_reference, branch_geometry_source_reference. reducer/valve/flange: rigid_pipe_ref, rigid_body_length, end_a_size, end_b_size, weight, center_of_gravity {x,y,z,unit}, connection_end_a_reference, connection_end_b_reference, stiffness_behavior_reference, rigid_component_source_reference; reducer eccentric_offset {x,y,z,unit} must equal its pipe's transverse node separation. expansion_joint: pressure-free mechanics_interface {solver_consumption "not_solver_consumed"}; exact route objective_connector (ask the person for its stiffness, axes and offsets). create/Support/create_support/supports [none; dimensionless; not_present]: node, restraints (at least one of UX..RZ), family (anchor, guide, line_stop, vertical_support, spring, variable_spring_hanger, spring_hanger, constant_effort_support, nonlinear), optional stiffness {dof, value}, hanger, nonlinear {behavior gap|lift_off|one_way|friction, dof (not linearly restrained), initial_state, gap+closes_when | contact_when | active_when | friction_coefficient+normal_reaction_source}. modify/Support/update_support/configuration [none; dimensionless; read_records before]: whole new configuration. create/Load/create_load_case/load_cases [none; dimensionless; not_present]: kind "primitive_user_load", status "preview_only". create/Load/create_primitive_load/primitive_loads, target.ref the case [magnitude unit; its dimension; not_present]: category thermal (element pipe, global_x, temperature_interval), distributed_force (element pipe, global_x|y|z, force_per_length), concentrated_force (node, global_x|y|z, force), concentrated_moment (node, rotation_x|y|z, moment), imposed_displacement (support+dof, direction = dof, displacement|rotation). Exact route only: modify/Load/update_load/pressure_regions [none; dimensionless; not_present] after "[]"; then modify/Model/set_field/pressure_profile, target.ref projectId [none; dimensionless; summary pressureProfileBefore]: {schema_version, pressure_contract {version "3.0.0", mode "exact_pressure_v3", shear_model}}; modify/Component/set_field/objective_connector.hardware|pressure_model [none; dimensionless; read_records before]. Deletes delete/<type>/delete_component|delete_support|delete_pipe_run|delete_node [none; dimensionless; read_records delete text] after "deleted" (component) or "not_present"; refused while referenced. Build in phases of at most the summary's operation limit, each applied before the next: geometry; components; supports; loads. Never author k or SIF: right after the components phase, ask the person to realize each bend (Insert bend at corner) and enter k, SIFs and their source, and tee modifiers; supports and loads must not attach to a corner before. On the exact route a solve is refused until every bend is realized; on the pressure-free route an unrealized bend solves as a straight chord (k does not affect chord stiffness; a supplied positive scalar SIF applies to the chord, and without one no intensified measure is published), and you must say so when reporting.
